# Optimum Prime Solutions Ltd

> Certified TallyPrime partner in Kenya, providing TallyPrime licensing, implementation, training, cloud hosting, KRA eTIMS compliance, and EOS® (Entrepreneurial Operating System) business consulting. Based in Ruiru, serving businesses nationwide across Kenya.

Optimum Prime Solutions Ltd is Kenya's certified reseller and implementation partner for TallyPrime — accounting, inventory, payroll and invoicing software used by over 2.5 million businesses worldwide. The company also provides secure cloud hosting for remote TallyPrime access, applies the EOS® leadership framework in its consulting work, and supports Biz Analyst, the official TallyPrime mobile companion app.

## Services

- [TallyPrime Implementation](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/implementation): End-to-end setup, data migration and go-live support for TallyPrime Silver, Gold and Enterprise editions.
- [TallyPrime Licensing](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/licensing): Genuine TallyPrime licences (Silver, Gold, Enterprise editions) with local support.
- [TallyPrime Cloud Hosting](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/cloud-hosting): Secure, always-on remote access to TallyPrime data from any device.
- [TallyPrime Training](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/training): Hands-on user and admin training, delivered on-site or remotely.
- [TallyPrime Support](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/support): Ongoing technical support, average response time under 1 hour.
- [Customization (TDL)](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/tallyprime/customization): Custom TallyPrime development using Tally Definition Language.
- [Industries Served](https://www.optimumprimesolutions.co.ke/industries): Tailored TallyPrime solutions for retail, wholesale/distribution, manufacturing, SACCOs & MFIs, hardware & construction, pharmacies, supermarkets, and education/NGOs.

## Compliance

- KRA eTIMS Compliance: TallyPrime is a KRA-approved eTIMS solution, compliant with Kenya's e-invoicing mandate (2026).
